cross_row_leads.facts: Gazprom.com Dec-2018 press release: Ukhta-Torzhok 2 ('String II'/P1439) gas pipeline, together with Bovanenkovskoye field's final gas-production facility, was brought into operation in Dec 2018. Construction on Ukhta-Torzhok 2 began in 2015 (per the companion gazprom.ru archive project page, which covers both String I and String II on one page). Confirms P1439's StartYear/ConstructionYear are distinct from P0767's (2011 construction/2012-13 start) -- the two are separate, sequentially-built parallel lines on the same corridor, never to be merged or cross-cited.

Gazprom Transgaz Ukhta's Gryazovets LPUMG (Line Production Directorate for Main Gas Pipelines) branch anniversary article: the ORIGINAL Ukhta-Torzhok corridor ('Vuktyl' generation, first stage commissioned 1969) is a separate, older pipeline family from both P0767/P1439 (2011-2018 'Yamal' generation). This article's own subject is the 1969-era line, likely corresponding to one or more of P5541/P5542/P5543 on the roster (not independently verified against each specific PID's own sheet row in this pass, since this audit was scoped to P0767 only) -- flagging for whichever future batch covers those PIDs to confirm which specific 1969-era Ukhta-Torzhok PID(s) this branch/article corresponds to, and to use Gryazovets LPUMG as a likely Operator candidate for that generation as well.
